newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse edges lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse edges lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down 0.15 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 540.38 from 541.20 on Thursday.
Volume was 268,910 dinars against 4.44 million dinars.
Cola and beer bottler SFBT SFBT was up 7.46 dinars to 92.44 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia eased 0.5 dinar to 42.48 dinars. ($= one dinar)
